gen_videos.name: gen_videos
gen_videos.description:
Generate video files from text prompts or images. USE THIS TOOL when user asks to
"create a video", "make a clip", "generate video". Unified entry point for text-to-video (T2V)
and image-to-video (I2V).
Max 5 requests per call. Duration: 6 or 10 seconds. Resolution: 768P or 1080P.
Output: downloadable video file (.mp4).

REQUIRED format — use 'video_requests' array (NOT 'requests', 'videos', or flat parameters):
  Text-to-video: {"video_requests": [{"prompt": "A cat playing", "output_file": "cat.mp4"}]}
  Image-to-video: {"video_requests": [{"prompt": "Cat runs", "output_file": "run.mp4", "image_file": "cat.png"}]}

Prefer this tool over batch_text_to_video / batch_image_to_video — it handles both T2V and I2V.

image_file.description: First frame image path in sandbox (for I2V)

batch_text_to_video.name: batch_text_to_video
batch_text_to_video.description:
Batch generate videos from text prompts (parallel-list format).
Max 5 per call. Duration: 6 (default) or 10 seconds. Resolution: 768P (default) or 1080P.
Prefer gen_videos for simpler usage — this tool uses parallel lists that must all match 'count'.

REQUIRED: count, prompt_list, output_file_list (all lengths must equal count).
Example: {"count": 2, "prompt_list": ["Sunset", "Ocean"], "output_file_list": ["s.mp4", "o.mp4"]}

prompt_list.description: List of text prompts for each video

output_file_list.description: List of output file paths (.mp4) in sandbox

duration_list.description: Duration for each video: 6 (default) or 10 seconds

batch_image_to_video.name: batch_image_to_video
batch_image_to_video.description:
Generate videos from images.
Max 5 requests per call. Duration defaults to 6s, resolution to 768P.

image_file_list.description: List of image file paths in sandbox

output_file_list.description: List of output file paths (.mp4) in sandbox

prompt_list.description: List of prompts describing video content

reference_type_list.description: How to use each image: 'first_frame' (default) or 'subject'

duration_list.description: Duration for each video: 6 (default) or 10 seconds

get_voice_list.name: get_voice_list
get_voice_list.description: Get all available voices for text-to-speech (TTS). Returns voice_id and voice_name. Call this before using synthesize_speech, batch_synthesize_speech, or batch_text_to_audio to choose a voice.

batch_text_to_audio.name: batch_text_to_audio
batch_text_to_audio.description:
Convert text to spoken audio (TTS / text-to-speech). USE THIS TOOL for voiceover, narration,
dialogue, podcast, or reading text aloud.
For music/song generation, use batch_text_to_music instead.

Each parameter list should have the same order as text_list. Optional parameters default to None.
Max 10 audios per call. Output: .mp3 audio files.

Example:
{"count": 2, "text_list": ["Hello world", "Welcome"], "output_file_list": ["hello.mp3", "welcome.mp3"]}

text_list.description: Text list to generate speech from

voice_list.description: Voice ID for each audio (from get_voice_list)

emotion_list.description: Emotion: happy, sad, angry, fearful, disgusted, surprised, neutral

batch_text_to_music.name: batch_text_to_music
batch_text_to_music.description:
Generate songs and music audio files from text prompts and lyrics. USE THIS TOOL when user asks
to "create a song", "generate music", "make a beat", "compose", or any request involving music/song creation
that expects an AUDIO FILE output (not just text lyrics).

Lyrics are OPTIONAL — omit lyrics_list for pure instrumental/background music.
Supports up to 1 minute per track, max 5 per call. Output: downloadable audio file (mp3/wav).
When lyrics are provided, use newline (
) to separate lines. Supports tags [Intro][Verse][Chorus][Bridge][Outro].

REQUIRED format — use parallel lists with matching 'count':
  With lyrics: {"count": 1, "prompt_list": ["Pop, sad"],
    "lyrics_list": ["[Verse]\nRain falls..."], "output_file_list": ["song.mp3"]}
  Instrumental: {"count": 1, "prompt_list": ["Calm piano BGM"],
    "output_file_list": ["bgm.mp3"]}

prompt_list.description: Music creation prompt (style, mood, scene). Char range: [10, 300]

lyrics_list.description: Song lyrics with structure tags. Char range: [10, 600]

format_list.description: Audio format: mp3, wav, or pcm

synthesize_speech.name: synthesize_speech
synthesize_speech.description:
Synthesize a single spoken audio clip from text (TTS).
For music/song generation, use batch_text_to_music instead.
Max text 10000 chars. Use get_voice_list for system voices or clone_voice for custom voices.

voice_id.description: Voice ID (system or cloned). Default: male-qn-qingse

batch_synthesize_speech.name: batch_synthesize_speech
batch_synthesize_speech.description:
Batch speech synthesis — generate multiple spoken audio clips at once (TTS).
For music/song generation, use batch_text_to_music instead.
Max 10 per call. Output files must be .mp3.

listen_audio.name: listen_audio
listen_audio.description:
Analyze one audio deeply. Audio will not be displayed to the user.
Maximum 1 audio file or URL per call.

Supports: mp3, wav, aiff, aac, ogg, flac, m4a.

url.description: Audio URL (supports mp3, wav, aiff, aac, ogg, flac)

audios_understand.name: audios_understand

videos_understand.name: videos_understand
videos_understand.description:
Analyze and understand video content (describe, extract info, answer questions about video).
NOT for generating video — use gen_videos or batch_text_to_video for generation.
Maximum 10 videos per call.

REQUIRED format — use 'video_info' array (NOT 'video_list', 'videos', or 'tasks'):
  {"video_info": [{"file": "/absolute/path/to/video.mp4", "prompt": "Describe this video"}]}
  {"video_info": [{"url": "https://cdn.example.com/video.mp4", "prompt": "Analyze"}]}
File paths must be absolute (e.g. /Users/...), do NOT use file:// URIs.

video_info.description: List of video info objects (max 10). Also accepts 'videos_info' as alias.

extract_content_from_websites.name: extract_content_from_websites
extract_content_from_websites.description:
Extract content from multiple websites(mime type html) concurrently. The extracted content will be returned in JSON format. DO NOT use this tool to read local files!
**NEVER** use this tool to extract pdf url, use `extract_pdfs_key_info` or `extract_pdfs_full_content` instead.

Safety Check:
    - All extracted content will be checked for safety compliance.
    - If content fails safety check with "safety_check_failed" error, DO NOT retry or use alternative methods.
    - Safety check failures are final - abandon the extraction and move on to other tasks.

tasks.description: List of extraction tasks. Maximum 10 tasks per call.

url.description: The URL of the website to extract content from. Must start with https:// and be a valid web address.

prompt.description: The prompt to extract specific information from the website.

task_name.description: Optional. The name for this extraction task.

mode.description: Extraction strategy. 'auto': Try HTTP GET first, fallback to browser if needed (default). 'curl_only': Direct HTTP GET only. 'browser_only': Browser rendering only.

batch_web_search.name: batch_web_search
batch_web_search.description:
Web Search API, works like Google Search. At most 10 queries per request.

Search Strategy:
    - If valid results are fewer than 5, try searching page 2 by setting cursor=2
    - If no valid results found, try changing search keywords
    - Valid results are those that pass safety checks (filtered results don't count)

Safety Check:
    - All search results are automatically checked for safety compliance.
    - Results that fail safety check are automatically filtered out.
    - If all results are filtered, consider changing search keywords instead of retrying the same query.

queries.description: List of search queries. At most 10 queries per batch.

query.description: Search query string. Use 3-5 keywords. Add the current date for time-sensitive queries.

num_results.description: Number of results to return. Suggested is 10. Defaults to 10.

cursor.description: The cursor/page to search in. Default is 1.

data_range.description: Optional time range: h (hour), d (day), m (month), y (year).

search_type.description: Type of search. 'search' for general search (default).

image_reverse_search.name: image_reverse_search
image_reverse_search.description: Reverse image search. Returns similar images and related search queries.

image_url.description: The URL of the image to search for. Must be a publicly accessible image URL.

output_file.description: The file to save the search results. Should be a .md file.

images_search_and_download.name: images_search_and_download
images_search_and_download.description:
Search and download images. At most 10 queries per request.
This method is designed to be robust - individual task failures will not affect other tasks.

Safety Check:
    - All downloaded images are automatically checked for content safety.
    - Images that fail safety check will be deleted and excluded from results.
    - DO NOT retry downloading images that failed safety check.

queries.description: List of image search queries. At most 10 queries per batch.

query.description: Image search query. Use proper keywords for best results.

prompt.description: A simple sentence prompt to describe the image you want.

task_name.description: Name of the task, used to identify and organize downloaded images.

images_list.name: images_list
images_list.description: List available images in workspace. Returns a list of image file paths.

start.description: Start index for pagination. 0 for the first image. Defaults to 0.

number.description: Number of images to list. Use -1 to list all images. Defaults to -1.

deploy_html_presentation.name: deploy_html_presentation
deploy_html_presentation.description:
Deploy a directory of individual HTML slide files as a unified presentation with navigation controls.

This tool validates image references, combines slide HTML files into a single presentation viewer HTML, and deploys it.

Requirements:
- slides_dir must be an absolute path containing slide HTML files and an optional imgs/ subdirectory
- All images must be under an 'imgs/' subdirectory
- Image references must use bare relative paths (e.g. 'imgs/photo.png'), NOT absolute or '../' paths
- HTTP/HTTPS URLs and data URIs are allowed

Slide ordering:
- If html_files is provided, slides are ordered as listed
- If omitted, all .html files are sorted by natural order (slide2.html < slide10.html)

slides_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory containing individual HTML slide files

html_files.description: Optional ordered list of HTML slide filenames relative to slides_dir. If omitted, all .html files are used in natural sort order.

upload_to_cdn.name: upload_to_cdn
upload_to_cdn.description:
Upload a file to CDN and return the public CDN URL.

**IMPORTANT: When sending files via messaging platforms (Telegram, Slack, etc.),
you MUST use this tool first to get a CDN URL.**

Local file paths are NOT accessible outside the agent environment.
Only CDN URLs can be accessed by external services.

Returns:
    cdn_url: Public CDN URL

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file to upload
